title: The Broken Flask

questions.question: Thus says the Lord, "Go, buy a potter's earthenware..., and take some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:1 (ESV): "Go, buy a potter's earthenware flask, and take some of the elders of the people and some of the elders of the priests,"

questions.question: Where was Jeremiah supposed to go with the flask and the elders?
options: The Valley of the Son of Hinnom
questions.correctAnswer: The Valley of the Son of Hinnom
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:2 (ESV): "and go out to the Valley of the Son of Hinnom at the entry of the Potsherd Gate, and proclaim there the words that I tell you."

questions.question: The Lord said he was bringing such disaster upon that place that "the ears of everyone who hears of it will..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:3 (ESV): "Behold, I am bringing such disaster upon this place that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle."

questions.question: "Because the people have forsaken me and have profaned this place by making offerings in it to... , whom neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah have known;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:4 (ESV): "making offerings in it to other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah have known;"

questions.question: "...and because they have filled this place with the blood of..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:4 (ESV): "and because they have filled this place with the blood of innocents,"

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:5 (ESV): "and have built the high places of Baal to burn their sons in the fire as burnt offerings to Baal,"

questions.question: "...therefore, behold, days are coming, declares the Lord, when this place shall no more be called Topheth, or the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, but the Valley of..."

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:8 (ESV): "and will hiss because of all its wounds."

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:9 (ESV): "And I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and their daughters,"

questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:10 (ESV): "Then you shall break the flask in the sight of the men who go with you,"

questions.question: "...and shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord of hosts: So will I... this people and this city, as one... a potter's vessel, so that it can never be mended.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:11 (ESV): "So will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter's vessel, so that it can never be mended."

questions.question: "Men shall bury in Topheth because there will be no place else to..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:11 (ESV): "Men shall bury in Topheth because there will be no place else to bury."

questions.question: After returning from Topheth, where did Jeremiah stand to declare to all the people that the Lord was bringing disaster upon the city?
options: The court of the Lord's house
questions.correctAnswer: The court of the Lord's house
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 19:14 (ESV): "Then Jeremiah came from Topheth, where the Lord had sent him to prophesy, and he stood in the court of the Lord's house,"

key_verse_text: Then you shall break the flask in the sight of the men who go with you, and shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord of hosts: So will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter's vessel, so that it can never be mended.'
